description:
PLAT-01: the OpenTelemetry export bridge, spans, metrics and
        log-correlation identifiers derived from ai.ravenroot.api.application.ExecutionEvent, the
        same event ai.ravenroot.server.audit.StructuredExecutionLogger already consumes. Depends on
        ravenroot-application-api (the event shape) and ravenroot-core (ExecutionMonitor.subscribe,
        the only extension point this module uses) and nothing else in the ai.ravenroot tree. Neither
        of those two modules, nor ravenroot-application-api's other consumers, every third-party
        node package, depends on this one: the OpenTelemetry SDK is reachable from exactly one kind
        of caller, a composition root (RavenrootServerMain, RavenrootCliMain), which is what makes
        "no OpenTelemetry dependency in core" a property the compiler enforces rather than prose.
        Disabled unless RAVENROOT_OTEL_ENABLED is set; see
        TelemetryConfiguration. Every OpenTelemetry artifact here is Apache License 2.0; this module
        has not been through the release SBOM and licence scan and should be before it
        ships in a tagged release.
